⌈

Syntax

Dlt_ApplicationIDType appId,
Dlt_ContextIDType contextId,
Dlt_MessageLogLevelType newLogLevel
)
Service ID [hex]
0x08
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
appId
ID of the SW-C
